name: button-group
description: Lays out every native button in a ControlGroup side by side with one registry button variant, and keeps the caller's Button controls, roles, and labels.
accessibility: The group keeps the caller's native Button controls and exposes the row as one accessibility container.
The group keeps each button's visible or derived accessibility label and role.
The group inherits layout direction, control size, enabled state, and Dynamic Type behavior.
Provide labels for icon-only buttons through native Button initializers.
